title: Evaluation of the Edmonds determinant
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $A$ be an $n\times n$ Boolean matrix, and let $a_{ij}\in R$ be specified for every pair of indices. Form the polynomial matrix whose $(i,j)$ entry is the variable indexed by $(i,j)$ when $A_{ij}$ is true and zero otherwise, and evaluate its determinant by substituting $a_{ij}$ for each variable. The result equals the determinant of the matrix with entries $a_{ij}$ where $A_{ij}$ is true and zero elsewhere.
hypotheses_covered: A value $a_{ij}\in R$ is specified for every pair of indices
